app.name: Eyadati
app.tagline: Cloud clinic management platform for Saudi Arabia

common.notFoundDescription: The page may have moved or the link is incorrect.
common.conflictBody: Reload to see the latest version, then re-apply your changes.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.

validation.invalid_saudi_mobile: Enter a valid Saudi mobile, e.g. 05XXXXXXXX.
validation.invalid_national_id: Enter a valid national ID / Iqama number.
validation.invalid_vat_number: Enter a valid VAT number (15 digits, starts and ends with 3).
validation.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
validation.weak_password: Password must be at least 10 characters with letters and digits.
validation.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
validation.same_password: The new password must be different from the current one.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your clinic.
login.invitationNotice: Sign in with the account the invitation was sent to, then confirm it.

register.title: Register a new clinic
register.subtitle: Create your clinic account and start your trial right away.
register.slugHint: Optional — lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. al-shifa
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with letters and digits.
register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms and the privacy policy

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If this email is registered, you'll receive a reset link within a few minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password for your account.
reset.doneBody: Your password was updated and all previous sessions were ended. Sign in with the new password.

invitation.title: Accept invitation
invitation.subtitle: Set a password for your new account to accept the invitation and join the clinic team.
invitation.doneBody: Welcome to the team. You can sign in now.
invitation.failed: The invitation couldn't be accepted. Try again.
invitation.invalidBody: It may have been used already, expired or been cancelled. Ask the clinic to send a new invitation.
invitation.joinedBody: You're now part of the clinic team.
invitation.openClinic: Open the clinic to get started:
invitation.signedInSubtitle: Your current account will join the clinic team once you accept.
invitation.wrongAccountBody: This invitation was sent to a different account. Sign out, then sign in with the invited account.
invitation.switchAccount: Sign in with the invited account
invitation.notYou: Not your account? Sign in with another one

setPassword.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with letters and digits.
setPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it directly from the email.

verify.title: Verify email
verify.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it directly from the email.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
challenge.recoveryHint: Each recovery code works only once.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.subtitle: Platform accounts must use an authenticator app. Set it up now to continue.
enroll.failed: The setup could not be started.
enroll.step1: 1. Add this account to your authenticator app
enroll.step1Hint: In the app choose “enter a setup key” and type the key below, or open the link on a phone that has an authenticator app.
enroll.step2: 2. Enter the code the app shows

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.subtitle: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once.
codes.warning: They are shown only now. Store them offline, apart from your password. You can replace them later from the security page.
codes.saved: I have saved these recovery codes

shell.noClinicTitle: You don't have access to a clinic
shell.noClinicDescription: Your account isn't linked to any clinic yet. Ask the clinic administrator to send you an invitation.
shell.platformNoClinics: You're signed in with a platform administration account and aren't a member of any clinic. The platform console isn't part of this app.
shell.platformChoose: You're signed in with a platform administration account. Choose the clinic you want to work in.
shell.chooseClinicDescription: Choose the clinic you want to work in.
shell.forbiddenTitle: You don't have permission for this page
shell.forbiddenDescription: Ask your clinic manager if you need this access.
shell.verifyEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Verifying protects your account and enables password recovery.
shell.readOnlyDescription: Data is available to view and print only until the subscription is renewed. Contact support.
shell.suspendedDescription: The platform team has suspended this clinic's account. Contact support.

subscription.askOwner: Ask the clinic owner to upgrade the plan.
subscription.title: Subscription & plan
subscription.subtitle: Your current plan, usage limits and available features.
subscription.noSubscriptionHint: Contact support to activate the clinic's subscription.
subscription.cancelAtPeriodEnd: The subscription will be canceled at the end of the current period.
subscription.usageHint: Limits apply only when adding new items; your existing data always stays available.
subscription.limitReached: Limit reached — upgrade your plan to add more.
subscription.upgradeContact: The {plan} plan is activated manually by the platform team after payment. Contact support to request the upgrade.
subscription.expiredBody: You can still view and print all data, but nothing can be added or changed until the subscription is renewed. Contact support to renew.

appointments.title: Today's appointments
appointments.subtitle: Daily appointment board in clinic time.
appointments.emptyDescription: Book a new appointment or register a walk-in.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel appointment
cancelDialog.description: {patient}'s appointment will be cancelled and the time freed for booking.

reschedule.title: Reschedule appointment
reschedule.chooseDate: Choose today or a later date to see the free times.
reschedule.pastDate: You can't move an appointment to a past date.
reschedule.pickSlot: Choose one of the free times.
reschedule.slotTaken: The selected slot is no longer available. Please choose another time.

booking.title: Book appointment
booking.description: Choose the patient and doctor, then a free time.
booking.walkInDescription: The patient joins today's queue with a token number.
booking.chooseDoctorFirst: Choose a doctor to see available times.
booking.noSlots: No free times on this day. Try another day.

errors.slot: Choose one of the available times.

today.title: Today
today.loadFailed: Today's appointments could not be loaded.
today.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
today.truncatedBody: Showing the first {shown} of {total} appointments today.

queue.title: Waiting list
queue.description: Patients in the clinic, in order of arrival.
queue.emptyDescription: Patients appear here once they are checked in or registered as walk-ins.
queue.waitingFor: {minutes, plural, =0 {just arrived} one {waiting # min} other {waiting # min}}

upcoming.title: Coming up today
upcoming.description: Booked patients who have not arrived yet.
upcoming.more: {count, plural, one {# more appointment.} other {# more appointments.}}
upcoming.emptyDescription: Everyone booked today has arrived or been seen.

load.title: Workload by doctor
load.description: Sorted by outstanding work, so walk-ins can go to the least busy doctor.

picker.label: Patient
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, mobile or file number
picker.hint: Type at least two characters to search.
picker.noResults: No results. You can register a new patient from the Patients page.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: The clinic's patient registry — search by name, mobile, file number or ID.
patients.searchPlaceholder: Search name, mobile, file no. or ID
patients.noResultsHint: Try the start of the name, the full mobile number, or a file number like P-000012.
patients.emptyDescription: Start by registering the clinic's first patient.
patients.identityHint: 10 digits — national IDs start with 1, Iqamas with 2.
patients.notesHint: Administrative notes only — don't put medical information here.
patients.deleteDescription: {name}'s file can be deleted only if it was registered by mistake and has no appointments, visits or prescriptions. A patient with history can't be deleted.
patients.medicalConfidential: Confidential medical information — visible only to authorized staff.
patients.medicalHidden: Medical information is hidden — you don't have permission to view medical records.

duplicates.title: This patient may already be registered
duplicates.body: Patients with the same mobile or ID number exist. Check before creating a new file (families often share one mobile).

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.subtitle: Doctor profiles and working hours per branch.
doctors.addDescription: Pick a clinic team member to create a doctor profile for. To add someone new, invite them from the Staff page first.
doctors.created: Doctor profile created. Add working hours now.
doctors.notFoundDescription: This doctor doesn't exist or isn't in the branches you can access.
doctors.emptyDescription: Add a doctor profile for a team member to start taking bookings.
doctors.staffHint: Lists team members who don't have a doctor profile yet.

fields.licenseHint: Registration number with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties.
fields.isActiveHint: Deactivating stops new bookings; existing appointments are kept.

schedule.description: Set working periods for each day in clinic time. A day can have several periods (morning and evening).
schedule.otherBranchesKept: Only working hours in your branches are shown. The doctor's hours at other branches stay as they are.
schedule.invalid: Fix the highlighted periods: the end must be after the start, with no overlaps.

staff.title: Staff & roles
staff.subtitle: The clinic team, invitations, roles and permissions.
staff.inviteDescription: We'll email an invitation link that's valid for 7 days. They join the clinic only after accepting it.
staff.reinvited: New invitation sent. Access returns once it's accepted.
staff.revokeDescription: The invitation link sent to {email} will stop working.
staff.disableDescription: {name}'s access to this clinic will be disabled and their sessions ended. Restoring it sends a new invitation they must accept.
staff.branchesHintRestricted: Choose at least one of your branches.
staff.branchesHint: Leave all unchecked to allow every branch.

roles.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
roles.name: Role name
roles.escalationHint: You can't grant permissions you don't hold. Disabled permissions are outside your own access.
roles.deleteDescription: The role {name} will be deleted. Roles assigned to staff can't be deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Clinic details, branches and the service catalog.

clinic.title: Clinic business profile
clinic.name: Clinic name
clinic.slugHint: Used in the clinic page URL; can't be changed here.

branches.restrictedHint: You can edit your own branches only. Adding a branch is available to people who manage every branch.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.mainHint: The main branch can't be deactivated.

services.title: Services
services.emptyHint: Add services (consultation, cleaning, X-ray…) with durations and prices to use them when booking.
services.deleteDescription: The service {name} will be hidden. Past appointments keep their link to it.

visits.title: Visit
visits.chooseBranch: Choose the branch where the visit takes place.
visits.completeDescription: Once completed, the visit is locked and its content can't be changed, and its appointment is closed. You can still issue a prescription afterwards.
visits.completeDescriptionUnsaved: Your changes will be saved first. Then the visit is locked and its content can't be changed, and its appointment is closed.
visits.lockedBody: Completed on {time}. The clinical content is locked and can't be changed.
visits.readOnlyNotTreating: Only the treating doctor ({doctor}) documents and completes this visit; it is shown to you read-only.
visits.clinicalHidden: Clinical content is hidden — you don't have permission to view medical records.

hints.clinicalNotes: What you found on clinical examination.

prescriptions.listHidden: You don't have permission to view prescriptions.
prescriptions.noneForVisit: No prescription has been issued for this visit yet.
prescriptions.noneForVisitReadOnly: No prescription was issued for this visit.
prescriptions.immutableHint: A prescription can't be changed once issued. To correct it, issue a new one.

history.title: History
history.empty: No history for this patient yet.
history.appointmentsOnly: Appointments only — you don't have permission to view visits.
history.noClinical: Diagnoses and prescriptions are hidden — you don't have permission to view medical records.
history.truncated: Only the most recent history is shown.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Your password and the devices signed in to your account.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password, then the new one.
password.newHint: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
password.signsOutOthers: You'll be signed out on your other devices after the change.
password.done: Password changed. Your sessions on other devices were ended.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Active sessions of your account, newest first.
sessions.confirmBody: {device} will have to sign in again.
sessions.note: Ending a session signs that device out immediately.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, and when, in your clinic. Read-only.

filters.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

actions.auth_mfa_reset: Two-step verification reset by an operator

followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.subtitle: Return visits the doctors asked for, ready to book.
followUps.emptyDescription: Change the dates or the status to see others.
followUps.privacyNote: Only booking details are shown here; medical details stay in the visit record for those allowed to see them.

filters.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.subtitle: Your authenticator app and recovery codes. Required for platform accounts.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Ten one-time codes for when you cannot use your phone. Replacing them cancels all the old ones.
recovery.dialogDescription: Enter the current code from your authenticator app. A recovery code cannot be used here.
recovery.newCodesWarning: The old codes no longer work. These are shown only now — store them offline.

remove.title: Remove two-step verification
remove.description: You will be signed out everywhere and must set it up again at your next sign-in.
remove.dialogDescription: Confirm with your password and a code. All your sessions end, including this one.
